title: Large goals are grilled into decisions and tasks, and oversized PRs get a stacked split
body:
Source: operator 2026-11-19 marked Matt Pocock 'Watch me ship a 21,000-line feature with mattpocock/skills' (youtu.be/jVBlkOF8sHk, transcript in rss-news item 0e3384e12aa0) as very important; lead analysis mapped his loop onto KRN. Evidence: before building he runs grill-with-docs: the agent asks numbered why-questions one at a time, reads and extends a glossary and existing ADRs, and the answers become a spec and blocked tickets that leave the implementer few decisions; he splits a 21k-line result into stacked PRs labelled two-way/one-way doors. KRN starts lanes from a ready task body; nothing interviews the operator for a large goal or warns on a huge PR.
Files: .agents/skills/ (new grill skill), src/cli/pr*.ts, docs/program/repository-workflow.md
Outcome: a grill skill turns a large operator goal into a decision record (why, glossary terms, ADR when a real trade-off exists) and ready tasks with After: links; krn pr ship warns above a changed-line threshold and suggests a stacked split, and the PR body names one-way-door changes (schema, public API, deletion).
Proof: skill eval on one recorded large goal yields tasks that krn task check accepts; ship test shows the size warning above the threshold.
